iEEGCoordinateSystemDescription: MNI coordinates as provided by the authors (FieldTrip struct elec_mni_frvr, coordsys "mni"), obtained by volume-based normalisation of patient-space coordinates for illustration purposes. The exact MNI template variant is not stated in the release, so the BIDS label "Other" is used rather than guessing one.
iEEGCoordinateProcessingDescription: Stolk et al. (2018) pipeline: CT-MRI coregistration, electrode localisation, brain-shift compensation with a cortical hull (iso2mesh), volume-based normalisation to MNI. Anatomical labels from FreeSurfer fsaverage surface-based normalisation with the aparc+aseg atlas, confirmed by a neurologist.
